headline: Historic Island Access and Seasonal Tour Planning
reservation: Access to Heart Island and Dark Island is restricted to operating seasons, typically mid-May through October. While no park entry permit is required, boat tour tickets and castle admission are separate costs and often sell out during summer weekends. State park camping at Wellesley Island can book out nine months in advance, requiring an official New York State Parks check.

days.title: Gilded Age Castles and River Vistas

stops.name: Boldt Castle
stops.detail: Visit the 120-room Rhineland-style mansion on Heart Island, accessible only by water shuttle or private boat.

stops.name: Singer Castle
stops.detail: Explore the secret passages and clock tower of this massive granite structure on Dark Island.

days.driving: Allow 1–2 hours for boat transfers; conditions vary by river current.
days.note: Tours are highly weather-dependent; confirm ferry operations locally.

days.title: River Heritage and Maritime History

stops.name: Antique Boat Museum
stops.detail: View a world-class collection of wooden speedboats and vintage river craft.

stops.name: Rock Island Lighthouse State Park
stops.detail: Climb the lighthouse for panoramic views of the main Saint Lawrence shipping channels.

days.driving: Allow 15 minutes between towns; state park access requires a vessel.
days.note: Freighter traffic creates significant wakes; stay clear of main lanes.

days.title: Granite Shorelines and Nature Trails

stops.name: Minna Anthony Common Nature Center
stops.detail: Walk the wooded trails and visit the museum focused on the St. Lawrence ecosystem.

stops.name: Eel Bay
stops.detail: A shallow, protected bay ideal for observing migratory birds and aquatic life.

days.driving: Allow 20 minutes for island bridge transit; expect weekend congestion.
days.note: Bridge tolls apply to Wellesley Island; check vehicle height limits.

intel.title: Water-Only Landmarks
intel.text: Many iconic sites like Boldt Castle have no bridge access and require third-party shuttles. Verify shuttle return times as late-day service is limited.

intel.title: Seasonal Availability
intel.text: Most attractions close from November to April due to river icing. Late June is the transition into full daily operations for all charters.

intel.title: Marine and Road Supply
intel.text: Standard fuel is readily available in Alexandria Bay and Clayton. Boaters should identify marinas with marine-grade fuel before entering the remote island channels.

intel.title: Border Connectivity
intel.text: Cell signals may frequently switch to Canadian towers near the border. Check roaming settings to avoid unexpected international data charges while on the water.

intel.title: Mainland Launch Points
intel.text: Public parking in Clayton is concentrated near the museum and waterfront. Peak summer weekends see lots fill quickly near the Alexandria Bay tour docks.

plan.arrival: Pick up rental at ART and head to Watertown for major grocery supplies before the 30-mile drive north to Alexandria Bay check-ins.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are ideal for Seaway Trail driving. RVs should check bridge clearance for Wellesley Island.
plan.goldenHour: Scenic views from the Rock Island Lighthouse deck are best at dusk, subject to park closing times.
